provenance.note: Deposited biological assembly 3: barnase chain C and barstar chain F. Barnase chain C lacks the experimentally unresolved N-terminal Ala1/Gln2; the derived fixture explicitly models the crystallized C3-110 construct. The source publication describes barstar as a C40A/C82A double mutant; this is not a wild-type-only benchmark. No internal missing residues are silently bridged; the observed sequence is checked before use.
